ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/cream) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity contiguous blobs on both lobes, surrounded by low-intensity black perimeters. The right lobe high-intensity field contains a distinct localized low-intensity circular void.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex; estimated angle of 35 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular macro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude peaks at the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Consistent convex curve across the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) situated on the high-intensity field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular low-intensity marking on the mid-lower section of the right lobe; additional smaller irregular low-intensity spots visible on the left lobe's high-intensity region.
